# Draft:Shizuoka Professional University Junior College of Agriculture

is a pubilc junior college in Iwata city, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, established in 1900.
Location
* 678-1 Tomioka, Iwata-shi, Shizuoka-ken 438-0803
Organization
It has three courses and about 100 students including men and women.
